usageNotes: Removes an LVM Volume Group from the specified node; the return value is a task UPID, so poll the task API to confirm completion before reusing the underlying disks. The caller must hold `Sys.Modify` on `/`; if `cleanup-config` is set, `Datastore.Allocate` on `/storage` is also required. Ensure no VMs or containers have active storage references to this VG before invoking, as removal is immediate and irreversible.

examples.summary: Remove VG 'pve-data' from node 'pve01', wiping disks and cleaning up storage config

destructiveReason: Permanently destroys the LVM Volume Group and all logical volumes it contains; all data stored on those volumes is unrecoverable, and optionally wipes the underlying physical disks.
tips: Run 'get_nodes_node_disks_lvm' first to confirm the VG name and which physical disks back it before deleting.
Set 'cleanup-config: true' when the storage is defined only on this node; omit it if the storage definition should remain for other nodes in the cluster.
Set 'cleanup-disks: true' only when you intend to reprovision the raw disks — it writes zeros to the disk headers, making recovery impossible.
Track the returned UPID via the task API (e.g., 'get_nodes_node_tasks_upid_status') to detect failures before assuming the VG is gone.
